settings.title: System Settings & Operational Parameters
settings.subtitle: Manage workload quotas, schedule rules, file storage policies, and automated workflows across NexCampus
settings.saveError: Failed to update system settings. Please try again.
settings.unsavedDesc: You have modified operational parameters. Click 'Save Settings' to apply them or 'Discard changes' to undo.

categories.scheduleDesc: Define report submission cutoff times and intern reporting schedules
categories.workloadDesc: Control workload caps to prevent intern burnout and optimize department resources
categories.storageDesc: Manage maximum upload sizes for submission videos, attachments, and onboarding CVs
categories.automationDesc: Configure cross-department assignment policies and AI-assisted weekly evaluation

settings.dailyReportDeadlineDesc: Cutoff time for interns to submit their daily reports (Format HH:mm, e.g. 17:30)
settings.deadlineNextDayNotice: Cutoff time for today ({currentDeadline}) has passed. The new deadline ({newDeadline}) will take effect tomorrow ({effectiveDate}).
settings.deadlineActiveTodayNotice: Current cutoff time ({deadline}) is active today.
settings.workingDaysDesc: Standard weekly working days for interns. Can only be modified on Sunday.
settings.workingDaysSundayOnlyNotice: Working days per week can only be changed on Sunday (today is {currentDay}).
settings.workingDaysSundayAllowedNotice: Today is Sunday — you can adjust working days per week.
settings.maxActiveTasksDesc: Maximum number of in-progress tasks that can be assigned to an intern simultaneously
settings.maxWorkloadDaysDesc: Maximum cumulative estimated workload days allowed for an intern within the same period
settings.maxLeaderDepartmentsDesc: Maximum number of departments a single Team Leader can oversee
settings.submissionMaxFileSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for task submission demo videos and deliverable files
settings.reportAttachmentMaxSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for documents attached to daily reports
settings.reportVideoMaxSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for video clips attached to daily reports
settings.taskAttachmentMaxSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for documents attached when creating tasks
settings.applicationMaxSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size (in MB) for CVs and onboarding documents
settings.allowCrossDepartmentDesc: Allow leaders to assign tasks to interns belonging to other departments
settings.autoEvaluationDesc: Enable AI to automatically summarize reports and suggest 12-criteria evaluation scores

errors.workingDaysRange: Working days per week must be between 1 and 7 days
errors.tasksRange: Active tasks must be between 1 and 50
errors.workloadRange: Workload days must be between 1 and 90 days
errors.leaderDeptsRange: Managed departments must be between 1 and 10
errors.submissionSizeRange: Submission file size must be between 5 and 100 MB
errors.reportAttachmentSizeRange: Report attachment size must be between 1 and 100 MB
errors.reportVideoSizeRange: Report video size must be between 1 and 100 MB
errors.taskAttachmentSizeRange: Task attachment size must be between 1 and 100 MB
errors.applicationSizeRange: Application file size must be between 1 and 50 MB

resetModal.title: Confirm Reset to Factory Defaults
resetModal.desc: This action will reset all operational parameters to NexCampus factory default values. Are you sure you want to proceed?
resetModal.warning: Note: Any customized configurations will be overwritten. Click 'Save Settings' after resetting to apply to the server.
resetModal.resetSuccessToast: All parameters have been reset to factory defaults!

maintenance.title: System Maintenance Mode
maintenance.subtitle: Control system-wide user access during maintenance, database migrations, or scheduled upgrades
maintenance.confirmDisableDesc: All users will immediately regain full access to the system.
maintenance.confirmEnableDesc: Users without bypass permissions or roles will be blocked and redirected to the maintenance screen.

apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.subtitle: Generate and manage programmatic API keys for third-party tools and automated pipelines
apiKeys.revokeDesc: This API key will be permanently deactivated. Any integrations using it will immediately lose access.

reveal.title: Save Your Secret API Key
reveal.warning: This is the ONLY time your full secret key will be displayed. Copy and store it securely now.

webhooks.title: Webhook Endpoints
webhooks.subtitle: Send real-time event notifications to external web services using HTTP POST payloads

modal.secretPlaceholder: Leave blank to auto-generate a secure secret
